758:t_1:229.en:
$$クレア$$
「Thank you for coming to welcome us.」

758:t_1:230.en:
$$学園長$$
「Not at all... Thank you for all your hard work until today, Chairwoman.」

758:t_1:232.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「That repair of space-time brought us back to our original world, along with the academy.」

758:t_1:233.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Come to think of it, what happened to $$アクエリオン$$?」

758:t_1:234.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Does it matter? The fighting is over now.」

758:t_1:235.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You're right. Besides, if fighting ever breaks out again...」

758:t_1:236.en:
$$シュレード$$
「I'm sure $$アクエリオン$$ will return then.」

758:t_1:237.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「What we need to do in this world now is...」

758:t_1:238.en:
$$ジン$$
「To savor this peace with the people we love.」

758:t_1:241.en:
$$ドナール$$
「Y-you kids... Boys and girls dating is...!」

758:t_1:242.en:
$$スオミ$$
「That ban was lifted ages ago, wasn't it, Chairwoman?」

758:t_1:243.en:
$$クレア$$
「Yes. $$不動$$ has approved it too.」

758:t_1:244.en:
$$アンディ$$
「We did it, $$ＭＩＸ$$! Let's show everyone at the academy how close we are!」

758:t_1:246.en:
$$クレア$$
「But you are still immature...! There is so much more you must learn!」

758:t_1:247.en:
$$クレア$$
「You must make what you gained in this battle your own... Then take it with you as you set out for other worlds...」

758:t_1:248.en:
$$クレア$$
「When you meet your friends in $c again, show them how much you have grown.」

758:t_1:250.en:
$$カイエン$$
「All of the $$エレメント$$s wish to return to school.」

758:t_1:251.en:
$$クレア$$
「Very good. You will learn about true love there.」

758:t_1:253.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm ready for that, $$ミコノ$$.」

758:t_1:254.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yes. With you by my side, $$アマタ$$, I... think I'll be able to find it.」

758:t_1:255.en:
$$アマタ$$
(I love you, $$ミコノ$$... Even twelve thousand years from now, even a hundred and twenty million years from now...)

758:t_1:265.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Please give another big round of applause for the couple who became husband and wife here today.」

758:t_1:268.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Come to think of it, we've been waiting for it all this time.」

758:t_1:269.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「But now there are no battles or enemies left to get in your way!」

758:t_1:271.en:
$$シモン$$
「We're going to be happy, no matter what!」

758:t_1:273.en:
$$キヤル$$
「You two make a great couple!」

758:t_1:274.en:
$$キヨウ$$
「The two rings $$シモン$$ gave you... They look wonderful on you!」

758:t_1:275.en:
$$ニア$$
「These rings encouraged me and helped me keep going all this time.」

758:t_1:277.en:
$$ニア$$
「I'm the one who should thank you, $$シモン$$. We'll always be together from now on.」

758:t_1:278.en:
$$シモン$$
「Of course. Until the day our lives come to an end...」

758:t_1:279.en:
$$シモン$$
「It may be a short time compared with eternity, but let's live every moment of it to the fullest.」

758:t_1:281.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But are you sure, $$シモン$$? You can stay and relax a little longer.」

758:t_1:282.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's right. You could put off your departure a little and enjoy being newlyweds a bit more.」

758:t_1:283.en:
$$ニア$$
「No... We're not going to stop yet.」

758:t_1:284.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's right. Our journey will go on, breaking through the heavens and dimensions.」

758:t_1:289.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
($$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$... We'll soon begin preparing to welcome you back...)

758:t_1:290.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
(I'm sure I won't get to see you, but that will say 'Welcome home' to you in our place.)

758:t_1:293.en:
???
「Would you prefer that we call you Madam President?」

758:t_1:295.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I, $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$... have just returned.」

758:t_1:296.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I, $$オオタ・カズミ$$, have returned as well. Both of us are safe.」

758:t_1:297.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「What in the world is going on...!? And $$カズミ$$ has gotten younger!」

758:t_1:298.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll take our time explaining all of that now.」

758:t_1:299.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Yes... We'll tell you about our battle across twelve thousand years...」

758:t_1:300.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「...I was going to make welcoming you home a worldwide undertaking, and now it's all gone to waste...」

758:t_1:301.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's not true! We were able to protect the universe thanks to it!」

758:t_1:302.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Thank you, $$ユング#pilot$$. Your 'Welcome home'... reached us loud and clear.」

758:t_1:303.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「But now that we've met again like this, let me say it once more.」

758:t_1:304.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「Welcome home, $$ノリコ$$ and $$カズミ$$.」

758:t_1:307.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I'll be waiting, everyone... Come visit our world someday.)

758:t_1:311.en:
$$チコ$$
「...They really work us hard, don't they? They've already given us another assignment.」

758:t_1:312.en:
$$カシオ$$
「There are no $$宇宙怪獣$$ left now. We $$トップレス$$ need to find other work too.」

758:t_1:313.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It isn't just the $$トップレス$$. That's true of all humanity.」

758:t_1:314.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're venturing beyond the Solar System... And sending a delegation to the $$独立同盟シリウス$$ for the first time in millennia... Time, which stood still, is moving again.」

758:t_1:315.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's wonderful that we'll be part of that delegation.」
